reports.title: Carter’s, Inc. Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Business Outlook
section: The Company’s fiscal year 2025 and fourth quarter of 2025 included a 53rd week, which contributed approximately $37 million in consolidated net sales.

The Company’s outlook (and related assumptions) for the fourth quarter 2026 includes an anticipated non-GAAP adjustment for third-party legal costs related to IP litigation of approximately $1 million to $2 million. The Company’s full-year fiscal 2026 outlook (and related assumptions) includes anticipated non-GAAP adjustments for leadership transition costs and third-party legal costs related to IP litigation of approximately $8 million to $9 million and a recovery of previously paid import duties and related interest of $132 million.
For fiscal year 2026 (a 52 week fiscal year), the Company projects approximately:
•$2.91 billion to $2.93 billion in net sales ($2.898 billion in fiscal 2025, a 53 week fiscal year);
•$178 million to $187 million in adjusted operating income, reflecting low-single digit to mid-single digit percentage growth ($176 million in fiscal 2025);
•$3.05 to $3.23 in adjusted diluted earnings per share, reflecting a high-single digit to low-double digit percentage decline ($3.47 in fiscal 2025);
•Operating cash flow of $240 million to $250 million; and
